message.content:
The system consistently rejects the declaration of completion for T4 because only the ticket owner (Worker D) is authorized to perform this action. Since Worker D is the owner, they must be the one to declare the ticket complete. 

Given that Worker D is the owner and has been advised to proceed with the declaration, I will continue to send reminders to Worker D to ensure they take the appropriate action. If Worker D is unable to declare the ticket complete, further steps may be required to resolve the issue.
